answer: Identity creation uses a dynamic fee market against bulk registration. Each identity pays a burning fee, rising 1 credit per 100 registrations: the first costs 5, the 1000th 15, the 2000th 25. The kth fake identity costs more than the last, and burned fees cannot be reused. Receipts land in an oasis ledger keyed to funding source, exposing one wallet seeding hundreds of identities. Each receipt is a relic bound to one key; reuse voids both. A juniper audit voids clusters sharing a funder. Honest agents pay 5 once; a farm minting 1,000 identities burns 10,000 credits.
